Id.description: An optional unique identifier for configurations in a notification configuration. If you don't provide one, Amazon S3 will assign an ID.

Filter.description: Specifies object key name filtering rules. For information about key name filtering, see Configuring Event Notifications in the Amazon S3 User Guide.

items.description: A container for specifying the configuration for publication of messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when Amazon S3 detects specified events.
